editorialSummary.heading: Shortened first and last days, with spring break in April
highlights: The first and last student days both have early release
The Suwannee River Fair closure is March 15-17; spring break is April 10-18
Christmas break includes January 4; students return January 5
paragraphs: The first day back, August 10, is a shortened school day. So is the last day, May 28. Homecoming on October 16 and the second-term ending on December 18 bring the year’s early-release total to four. The annual calendar gives the dates without pickup times, so families will need their school’s dismissal notice for each one. Parent-teacher conferences fall on October 29 and February 11, immediately before student-free teacher workdays.

March has two separate interruptions before the April spring break. Students are off March 15-17 for the Suwannee River Fair, with classes scheduled again March 18. The third term ends March 19. Good Friday brings another day off March 26, followed by a scheduled March 29 return. Spring break comes later, April 10-18, and includes both weekends.

Christmas break runs through Monday, January 4, when teachers have a workday. Students return Tuesday, January 5. Near the end of the year, DCMHS graduation is May 21, a week before the district’s final class day. Final report cards are scheduled for June 7, after students have finished for the year.

faqs.question: When does Dixie County’s 2026-2027 school year start and end?
faqs.answer: The first student day is Monday, August 10, 2026, and the last is Friday, May 28, 2027. Both are early-release days, so families need to plan for a shorter schedule at the start and end of the year.

faqs.question: What are the early-release dates?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists four: August 10, October 16 and December 18, 2026, and May 28, 2027. October 16 is homecoming; December 18 ends the second term. The first and last student days also have early release.

faqs.question: What time do students leave on early-release days?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar marks four shortened days but does not give dismissal times. Check your child’s school or transportation notice for the pickup and bus schedule that applies on each date.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break runs Saturday, November 21 through Sunday, November 29, 2026. Students have nine consecutive days off, including both weekends. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Christmas break, and when do students return?
faqs.answer: Christmas break is December 19, 2026 through January 4, 2027, giving students 17 consecutive days without classes. January 4 is a teacher workday within the break. The calendar explicitly sets the student return for Tuesday, January 5.

faqs.question: When is spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Dixie’s spring break runs Saturday, April 10 through Sunday, April 18, 2027. Students are scheduled to return Monday, April 19. The break includes both weekends and five weekdays without classes.

faqs.question: Are schools closed for the Suwannee River Fair?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes March 15-17, 2027 for the Suwannee River Fair. They are scheduled to return Thursday, March 18. Friday, March 19 is the end of the third term and is not marked as another day off or an early-release day.

faqs.question: Is Good Friday a school holiday?
faqs.answer: Yes. There are no classes Friday, March 26, 2027, and students are scheduled to return Monday, March 29. That holiday is separate from the March 15-17 fair closure and the April 10-18 spring break.

faqs.question: Which teacher workdays are days off for students?
faqs.answer: Students have no school October 30, 2026 and February 12, 2027. January 4 is also a teacher workday, already included in Christmas break. The August 3-7 workdays take place before the school year begins.

faqs.question: How long is the Presidents Day weekend?
faqs.answer: Students are off Friday, February 12, 2027 for a teacher workday and Monday, February 15 for Presidents Day. Together with the weekend, that makes four consecutive days without classes. Students are scheduled to return Tuesday, February 16.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day a day off for students?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wednesday, November 11, 2026 is listed as Veterans Day with no school. Students are scheduled to return Thursday, November 12; the holiday does not extend through the rest of that week.

faqs.question: Are Labor Day and Martin Luther King Jr. Day school holidays?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students have no school Monday, September 7, 2026 for Labor Day and Monday, January 18, 2027 for Martin Luther King Jr. Day. The scheduled return is the following Tuesday after each holiday.

faqs.question: Is October 12 a school holiday?
faqs.answer: October 12, 2026 is listed as the end of the first term. It is not marked as a student holiday or early-release day. The October date with no school for students is Friday, October 30, a teacher workday.

faqs.question: When do the grading terms end?
faqs.answer: The four terms end October 12 and December 18, 2026, and March 19 and May 28, 2027. December 18 and May 28 have early release. October 12 and March 19 are not marked for a shortened schedule.

faqs.question: When are progress reports sent home?
faqs.answer: Progress reports are scheduled for September 10 and November 16, 2026, and February 10 and April 29, 2027. These are progress updates during each term; the calendar lists separate report-card dates after terms end.

faqs.question: When are report cards sent home?
faqs.answer: Report cards go home October 19, 2026, January 11, March 29 and June 7, 2027. The final report-card date is after the May 28 last day of classes; June 7 is not a student return date.

faqs.question: When are parent-teacher conferences, and do students have school?
faqs.answer: Parent-teacher conferences are October 29, 2026 and February 11, 2027. Neither date is marked as a student holiday or early-release day. The district homepage calls October 29 a conference night; confirm appointment times with your school.

faqs.question: When is Dixie County Middle-High School graduation?
faqs.answer: DCMHS graduation is Friday, May 21, 2027. The calendar does not give a ceremony time, location or separate senior last day. The district’s final student day remains May 28; graduating students should follow the school’s attendance and ceremony instructions.

faqs.question: How many student days does the calendar show?
faqs.answer: The listed dates work out to 179 scheduled attendance weekdays between August 10 and May 28, after excluding 31 no-school weekdays. The four early-release days still count as attendance dates. This is a calculation; the PDF does not print an annual student-day total.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official PDF and later calendar updates?
faqs.answer: The district’s Calendars page links the 2026-2027 PDF in Google Drive. The file is labeled Board Approved 6-25-26, and the calendar footer says Revised 6-25-26. Check district and school announcements for changes after that revision.
